propositions: bug_trends lens must aggregate 344 closed bugs across five dimensions: close_class distribution, detected_by distribution, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close percentiles

flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within ctx range; stock dimensions (open-bug age, detected_by, caused_by) measure point-in-time over current store independent of range
pre-convention bugs lacking close_class must surface as an explicit labeled MISSING cohort alongside vocabulary classes to prevent silent era mixing
detected_by field when sparse or absent must degrade that dimension to unavailable state without affecting other dimensions
zero-bug edge case must return unavailable per registry convention rather than crashing or empty response
